schema.standard: Chinese Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS)

source.report: Gotion High-Tech Co., Ltd. 2024 Annual Report

current.name: Cash and cash equivalents
current.description: Source field 货币资金; cash, bank deposits, and other monetary balances.

current.name: Trading financial assets
current.description: Source field 交易性金融资产; financial assets held for trading or measured through profit or loss.

current.name: Derivative financial assets
current.description: Source field 衍生金融资产; company-reported derivative assets preserved as an additional indicator.

current.name: Notes receivable
current.description: Source field 应收票据; commercial and bank acceptance notes receivable.

current.name: Accounts receivable
current.description: Source field 应收账款; trade receivables from customers.

current.name: Receivables financing
current.description: Source field 应收款项融资; receivables managed for collection and transfer.

current.name: Prepayments
current.description: Source field 预付款项; amounts paid before goods or services are received.

current.name: Other receivables
current.description: Source field 其他应收款; non-trade receivables not separately presented.

current.name: Inventory
current.description: Source field 存货; materials, work in progress, and finished goods.

current.name: Non-current assets due within one year
current.source_field: 一年内到期的非流动资产
current.description: Source field 一年内到期的非流动资产; non-current assets due within twelve months.

current.name: Other current assets
current.description: Source field 其他流动资产; current assets not presented elsewhere.

non_current.name: Debt investments
non_current.description: Source field 其他债权投资; non-current debt instruments mapped to the canonical debt-investment indicator.

non_current.name: Long-term investments
non_current.description: Source field 长期股权投资; long-term equity-accounted investments.

non_current.name: Equity investments
non_current.description: Source field 其他权益工具投资; non-current investments in other equity instruments.

non_current.name: Other non-current financial assets
non_current.description: Source field 其他非流动金融资产; company-reported financial assets preserved as an additional indicator.

non_current.name: Fixed assets
non_current.description: Source field 固定资产; property, plant, and equipment used in operations.

non_current.name: Construction in progress
non_current.description: Source field 在建工程; projects and equipment not yet ready for use.

non_current.name: Right-of-use assets
non_current.description: Source field 使用权资产; recognized rights to use leased assets.

non_current.name: Intangible assets
non_current.description: Source field 无形资产; identifiable non-monetary assets without physical substance.

non_current.name: Development expenditure
non_current.description: Source field 开发支出; qualifying development expenditure capitalized before transfer.

non_current.name: Goodwill
non_current.description: Source field 商誉; acquisition goodwill remaining after impairment.

non_current.name: Long-term deferred expenses
non_current.description: Source field 长期待摊费用; deferred expenses preserved as an additional non-current indicator.

non_current.name: Deferred tax assets
non_current.description: Source field 递延所得税资产; future tax benefits from deductible temporary differences.

non_current.name: Other non-current assets
non_current.description: Source field 其他非流动资产; non-current assets not presented elsewhere.

current.name: Short-term debt
current.description: Source field 短期借款; borrowings due within twelve months.

current.name: Notes payable
current.description: Source field 应付票据; commercial and bank acceptance notes payable.

current.name: Accounts payable
current.description: Source field 应付账款; trade amounts owed to suppliers.

current.name: Deferred revenue
current.description: Source field 合同负债; customer consideration received before performance obligations are satisfied.

current.name: Payroll payable
current.description: Source field 应付职工薪酬; accrued employee compensation and benefits.

current.name: Taxes payable
current.description: Source field 应交税费; taxes and statutory charges accrued but unpaid.

current.name: Other payables
current.description: Source field 其他应付款; company-reported miscellaneous payables preserved as an additional indicator.

current.name: Non-current liabilities due within one year
current.source_field: 一年内到期的非流动负债
current.description: Source field 一年内到期的非流动负债; current portion of long-term obligations.

current.name: Other current liabilities
current.description: Source field 其他流动负债; current obligations not presented elsewhere.

non_current.name: Long-term debt
non_current.description: Source field 长期借款; borrowings due after twelve months.

non_current.name: Lease liabilities
non_current.description: Source field 租赁负债; non-current unpaid lease obligations.

non_current.name: Long-term payables
non_current.description: Source field 长期应付款; company-reported long-term payables preserved as an additional indicator.

non_current.name: Provisions
non_current.description: Source field 预计负债; obligations of uncertain timing or amount.

non_current.name: Deferred income
non_current.description: Source field 递延收益; grants and other income recognized over future periods.

non_current.name: Deferred tax liabilities
non_current.description: Source field 递延所得税负债; future tax obligations from taxable temporary differences.

items.name: Share capital
items.description: Source field 股本; issued registered share capital.

items.name: Capital reserve
items.description: Source field 资本公积; share premium and other capital contributions.

items.name: Treasury shares
items.description: Source field 减：库存股; reported positive amount is treated as a deduction from equity.

items.name: Other comprehensive income
items.description: Source field 其他综合收益; accumulated gains and losses recognized outside profit or loss.

items.name: Special reserve
items.description: Source field 专项储备; statutory or industry-specific reserve.

items.name: Surplus reserve
items.description: Source field 盈余公积; appropriations from profit retained as a reserve.

items.name: Retained earnings
items.description: Source field 未分配利润; cumulative profit retained after distributions and appropriations.

items.name: Non-controlling interests
items.description: Source field 少数股东权益; subsidiary equity attributable to shareholders outside the parent group.
